description: IAS Signal display tag on pixel.adsafeprotected.com/rjss/st/{advertiserId}/{publisherId}/skeleton.js. Both IDs ride in the path. Video tags on unified.adsafeprotected.com are vendor/ias-video. Other IAS paths are not contracted.

params.name: advertiser_id
params.description: It is the IAS advertiser ID. Microsoft documents the IAS-generated display Tag URL as pixel.adsafeprotected.com/rjss/st/{advertiserId}/{publisherId}/skeleton.js.
params.fix_hint: Copy the Tag URL from IAS Signal Tag Manager so the path is /rjss/st/{advertiserId}/{publisherId}/skeleton.js.

params.name: publisher_id
params.description: It is the IAS publisher ID. Microsoft documents it as the second path segment on the display Tag URL.
params.fix_hint: Keep both path segments from the IAS Signal tag. The second is the publisher ID.
